title: Central–South Route 3 field validation
corridor: Chaguanas–San Fernando local Route 3 / Green Band
purpose: Validate whether a rider can actually follow TransitTrinidad directions on the Central–South corridor before broader public beta.

journeys.question: Can a rider hail the local southbound Green Band service in California and get off in Claxton Bay as modeled?
Does the local Chaguanas–San Fernando service carry a Couva rider through to Marabella without requiring a transfer?
Can a rider board/hail at Chase Village and remain on the same local Green Band service to San Fernando?
Is California a normal requested drop-off on the southbound Chaguanas–San Fernando local service?
What is the real northbound behavior from Claxton Bay toward Chaguanas, and where exactly should a rider board?
